name: Sofia Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport was unconventional. Originally trained as a statistician, she found herself drawn to the complex data streams of Formula 1 during a sabbatical. Intrigued, she started developing predictive models for a small IndyCar team, quickly proving her value. Her analytical approach is rigorous and detail-oriented, always striving to identify hidden patterns that can give ProSport Racing a competitive edge. 

Sofia excels at translating raw data into actionable insights for the engineers and drivers. She believes in clear communication and collaboration, though her lone wolf tendencies sometimes make her prefer working independently. Her distinctive ability to identify subtle performance bottlenecks has made her an indispensable asset to the team.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with streaks of gray
physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and usually tied back in a practical bun.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a slender build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook for jotting down observations.
Prefers to work in near-total silence, even during team debriefs.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deeply engrossed in data.
